Football entrance characters

The human mesh, morph targets, skin weights, skin textures, short02 hair, eyes
and eyebrows originate from MakeHuman Community's core assets (CC0).
https://github.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman
https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/makehuman_system_assets.html
https://static.makehumancommunity.org/about/license.html
The base T-shirt is T-shirt_basic_tucked by MargaretToigo / MRT (CC0).
https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/shirts01.html
The CC0 legal text is included as LICENSE.CC0.txt.

Modifications: male athlete morph, reduced 18-bone rig, fitted clothing and hair,
clipped hidden surfaces, football shorts, close crop, closed boots, mesh packing,
texture resizing and WebP conversion. Jersey artwork, knit, socks, boot textures,
foot placement, animation and independent entry choreography are project code.
The club crest retains FC Bayern's rights; see the repository's third-party notice.

These are generic character faces, not scans or exact likenesses of the players
whose names appear on the jerseys. No eFootball or EA Sports FC assets are used.
Build instructions: docs/PLAYER-ASSETS.md in the source repository.
